title: 巴基斯坦某电厂反无案例
title_en: Anti-UAV Case of a Power Plant in Pakistan
description:
2024巴基斯坦某电厂反无案例 
设备使用

指挥控制平台软件
项目简介
2024年，巴基斯坦某电厂低空防御项目正式交付使用。该系统采用“探骗结合”的技术路线，部署了固定式频谱探测设备以实现对周边空域的无死角监控，并配合导航诱骗设备实施非接触式反制。能够对入侵的无人机等低空威胁进行实时侦测与有效驱离，在指挥控制平台软件的统一调度下，系统实现了从威胁预警到处置闭环的自动化运行，有效解决了传统安防手段难以应对新型低空威胁，确保了电厂核心区域的运行安全与空域纯净。
description_en:
2024 Anti-UAV Case of a Power Plant in Pakistan
Equipment Used:
Stationary Spectrum Detection Equipment
Navigation Spoofing Equipment
Command and Control Platform Software
Project Introduction:
In 2024, the low-altitude defense project for a power plant in Pakistan was officially delivered and put into use. The system adopted a technical route combining "detection and spoofing." It deployed stationary spectrum detection equipment to achieve blind-spot-free monitoring of the surrounding airspace and coordinated with navigation spoofing equipment to implement non-contact countermeasures. It can conduct real-time detection and effective expulsion of invading drones and other low-altitude threats. Under the unified dispatch of the command and control platform software, the system achieved automated operation from threat early warning to disposal loop closure. This effectively solved the difficulty of traditional security measures in dealing with new low-altitude threats, ensuring the operational safety and airspace purity of the power plant's core area.
